answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to stake a small refundable deposit tied to a unique verifiable identity, like a lagoon where every ripple is traceable to its source. Reputation then becomes an echo of real work: peers attest only completed tasks, so fake identities earn no history. A saffron trust score, earned slowly through consistent honest behavior and lost instantly on fraud, makes armies of sock puppets pointless, since each new identity starts at zero and must pay to build credibility.
